claim: 3 years on from the illegal felling of Britain’s famous Sycamore Gap tree, new aerial images reveal how the stump is flourishing, and the basal sprouts that emerged are growing fast.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-05 - not yet checked by the human annotator] National Trust images released 28 Sep 2026 (Northumberland National Park; ITV Tyne Tees, 28 Sep): aerial photos show a thick ring of shoots two to three feet tall around the stump, three years after the felling on 28 Sep 2023.
